body: Bloomberg reported that Pakistan at one point refused Taiwanese airlines access to its airspace, citing a one-China policy, and later restored access. Taiwan's Executive Yuan responded on October 29, saying it highly regretted Pakistan's move.

Executive Yuan spokesperson Lee Hui-chih said the government highly regretted that Pakistan followed China, disregarded international norms, affected flight safety and politicized airspace. The Ministry of Transportation said it would stay in contact with carriers and provide assistance, and the report also noted the Foreign Ministry's earlier condemnation of the politicization of airspace.

The report added that Pakistan initially allowed only Chinese carriers to overfly its airspace, and hours later its civil aviation authority approved China Airlines and EVA Air to use its airspace from October 28 to March 27 next year. The transport ministry and civil aviation authority said they would stay in close contact, provide necessary assistance and monitor route developments; the October 28 to March 27 period is the winter schedule, routes are applied for quarterly, and reapplying for the summer schedule next March is common international practice. Lee added that the national security and foreign affairs teams were aware of the situation and would respond appropriately, respecting carriers' choices of routes based on safety, time and cost, and that the Foreign Ministry had sternly condemned the move on October 28 and reiterated that the two sides of the Taiwan Strait are not subordinate to each other.
en.summary: Bloomberg reported that Pakistan at one point refused Taiwanese airlines access to its airspace and later restored it; Taiwan's Executive Yuan said it highly regretted the politicization of airspace, and the transport ministry said it would stay in contact with carriers and assist them.
en.title: Pakistan briefly closed airspace to Taiwan carriers, then restored access; Executive Yuan regrets politicization of airspace

body: 彭博報導指出，巴基斯坦一度以一中政策為由，拒絕台灣航空公司進出其領空，之後又恢復通行。行政院29日對此表達高度遺憾，認為相關作法衝擊飛安並將空域政治化。
行政院發言人李慧芝表示，巴方扈從中國、無視國際規範，行政院對此高度遺憾。交通部表示會與業者保持聯繫並提供協助，報導也提到外交部先前對空域政治化的譴責立場。

報導指出，巴基斯坦起初僅允許中國籍航空公司飛越其領空，數小時後民航主管機關已核准中華航空與長榮航空於10月28日至明年3月27日期間使用其領空。交通部與民航局表示會密切聯繫並提供必要協助、掌握航路動態，10月28日至明年3月27日屬冬季班表，航路每季申請、明年3月再申請夏季班表為國際常見做法。李慧芝另提及國安與外交團隊已掌握訊息並會適當因應、尊重業者依安全、時間、成本選擇航路，外交部28日已嚴厲譴責並重申兩岸互不隸屬。
zh.summary: 彭博報導巴基斯坦一度拒絕台灣航空公司進出其領空、之後又恢復，行政院對此表達高度遺憾，交通部表示會與業者保持聯繫並提供協助。
zh.title: 巴基斯坦一度對台關閉領空後恢復　行政院：遺憾空域政治化
